articles.summary: Generative AI is only a few years old, so making it predictable and reliable means experimenting with different prompts, workflows, and techniques. Providing detailed instructions, constrained outputs, and layers of automated review can keep AI’s outputs predictable and easy to check. We’re applying what we can learn from other researchers, and trying some new routes of our own, all within corrections.
articles.title: How to Constrain AI to Do Its Job Well

articles.summary: Opportunities is now live across every state correctional facility in Arizona, through our partnership with Edovo—a digital learning platform that gives incarcerated people access to free educational, vocational, and personal development content. To date, over 29,000 individuals in Arizona have accessed the app. That statewide reach is what makes the partnerships with Inside Out Network (ION) and CEO possible, helping us connect people to new resources at exactly the right moment before release.
articles.title: A Bigger Bench: How Recidiviz is Partnering with Nonprofits to Scale Reentry Support
